description: Wildland fire suppression rates is a dataset listed in Ontario open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by data.ontario.ca. The Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry sets rates each year for the cost of aircraft, vehicles and equipment owned by the Crown and used for controlling or extinguishing a wildland fire. Coverage: Ontario. Its tags are Aviation Forest Fire and Emergency Services, Economy and Business, Environment and Natural Resources, Environnement et richesses naturelles, Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry. It offers 11 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-05-07 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ontario-portal.
